name: Samsung SDS Co., Ltd.
summary: Samsung SDS Co., Ltd. provides cloud and digital logistics platform-based logistics services in South Korea, the America, Europe, Asia, Africa, and China. It operates in IT Service and Logistics. The IT Service segment offers IT consulting, IT system design and development, system integration, information system operation and maintenance, data centers, and network service outsourcing solutions. The Logistics segment provides global logistics services, such as supply chain and logistics consulting and solutions.
